summary: GDPR and data protection are implemented with legal pages, middleware auth, and explicit governance. Live site has /privacy, /cookies, /terms, /acceptable-use, /review-policy routes. CSP header enforces strict content security: default-src 'self', script-src with nonce + strict-dynamic, frame-ancestors 'none', object-src 'none'. API middleware fails closed. Production README mandates safe defaults: all commercial/unapproved paths default to false. Legal risk register tracks data protection. Post-verification test (frontend/lib/post-verification.test.ts) validates account verification flow. Soft-delete DSAR support documented in prod-ready branches.
assertions: CSP: default-src 'self'; script-src nonce + strict-dynamic; frame-ancestors 'none'; object-src 'none'
Prod-ready branches include soft-delete-dsar, privacy-dpia-ico, cookie-banner-csp
README: safe defaults — all commercial/unapproved paths default to false
